newsitem.title: USA: Innkeepers sees hotel deal accretive in '97.
newsitem.headline: Innkeepers sees hotel deal accretive in '97.

text.p: Innkeepers USA Trust said Tuesday it had closed on the acquisition of nine hotels from privately held Summerfield Hotel Corp for about $118.6 million, and expected the deal to be accretive to earnings in 1997 and thereafter.
The acquisition price included about $89.5 million in cash and about $29.1 million in common operating partnership units valued at $15, the company said.
Innkeepers said the cash consideration in the deal was financed through a one-year term loan provided by Lehman Brothers priced at 30 day LIBOR plus 175 basis points.
The company also said it had acquired three Chicago-based Hampton Inns in June for $19.1 million in cash.
